title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: Linear independence means that no column in the design matrix can be written as a combination of the others. Why do you think this property is important for the uniqueness of the OLS solution?

title: OLS Solution Uniqueness
text: Consider what happens when the columns of the design matrix are linearly dependent. How might this affect the ability to find a unique solution for the parameters?

title: Checking Linear Independence
